description: This file defines a React component for a blog post editor page, incorporating features like real-time updates, rich text editing with TipTap, image uploads, and post management functions such as create, update, publish, and delete. It manages form state, debounced auto-saving, and routing for editing or creating posts.

methods.name: useDebouncedCallback
methods.description: Creates a debounced version of a callback function to delay execution until a specified timeout has passed without repeated calls.

methods.name: ensurePostId
methods.description: Ensures the post has a valid ID, creating a new post if necessary, and navigating appropriately.

methods.name: debouncedSave
methods.description: Automatically saves the post content and title after a debounce delay to prevent frequent network requests.

methods.name: handleUploadImage
methods.description: Handles image uploads by delegating to an abstracted upload function and returns the image URL.

methods.name: handleContentChange
methods.description: Handles updates to the rich text editor content, updating local state and triggering debounced save.

methods.name: handleTitleChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the post title input, updating state and triggering debounced save.

methods.name: handleManualSave
methods.description: Performs an explicit save of the current post title and content, with user feedback.

methods.name: handleTogglePublish
methods.description: Toggles the published state of the post, ensuring slug uniqueness before publishing.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the current post after user confirmation and navigates away.
